comps.name: Classic Wombo Combo
comps.win: Layer AoE CC + AoE damage at objectives. One combo = teamwipe.
play: Group for objectives after level 5
Malphite R → Amumu R → Orianna R Shockwave
MF R Bullet Time on stunned enemies for full channel
If behind, wait for enemy facecheck — one combo resets the game
counter: Spread out to avoid stacked AoE
Build Banshee's Veil / Edge of Night
synergies: Malphite R → Orianna R double knockup
Amumu R → MF R full channel
Leona R → Malphite R chain engage

comps.name: Protect the Kog'Maw
comps.win: Keep Kog'Maw alive with shields/heals/CC. He shreds everything with W %HP damage.
play: Survive early game. Kog farms and scales
Lulu stays next to Kog — W polymorph divers, R saves from burst
Orianna E ball on Kog for shield + R peel
Front-to-back teamfight: tanks engage, Kog melts from backline
counter: Dive Kog with multiple assassins to overwhelm peel
Win early — Kog is useless behind
Olaf R ignores all peel CC

comps.name: Protect the Jinx
comps.win: Jinx gets one kill → passive Get Excited → chain resets = pentakill.
play: Farm to 2 items. Jinx starts hypercarrying
Soraka R saves globally; Milio R cleanses ALL CC
Tanks engage front-to-back. Jinx rockets from max range
One reset = ace
counter: Flank with assassin (Jinx has no dash)
Win lane vs Jinx to deny scaling
Grievous Wounds to cut Soraka healing

comps.name: Yasuo Wombo Combo
comps.win: Knockup providers enable Yasuo R Last Breath on entire team.
play: Diana R pulls enemies → Yasuo R on grouped airborne enemies
Malphite R backup knockup
Nautilus R point-click knockup for Yasuo R
Windwall blocks key projectiles before engage
counter: Spread out — Yasuo R dangerous only on grouped knockups
Ban Yasuo or deny knockup providers
Janna R / Lulu R to peel after knockup

comps.name: Full Dive Comp
comps.win: All 5 dive enemy backline simultaneously. Overwhelm peel with numbers.
play: Leona/Nautilus engage first
Vi R locks carry → Akali bursts → Camille R traps second carry
Kai'Sa R follows any CC
If one diver peeled, others get through
synergies: Camille R + Vi R double lockdown
Akali shroud → Zed shadow for multi-flank

comps.name: Poke & Siege
comps.win: Poke enemies low before fights. Siege turrets with range.
play: Poke before every objective — enemies arrive half HP
Karma R+E gives team MS to kite
Ziggs W demolishes turrets
NEVER engage 5v5. Keep distance
counter: Hard engage forces fights before poke matters
synergies: Karma R+E team MS for kite

comps.name: Pick & Catch Comp
comps.win: Catch isolated enemies. Delete them. Fight 5v4 at objectives.
play: Vision control is EVERYTHING
Thresh hook or Ahri charm catches someone → team collapses
Jhin W root confirms picks from range
After pick, immediately take objective
counter: Group as 5 — picks only work on isolated targets
synergies: Thresh hook → Jhin W root chain
Ahri charm → Lee Sin Q follow

comps.name: Split-Push + Global
comps.win: Fiora splits (nobody can 1v1 her). TF R joins fights. Map pressure.
play: Fiora pushes side lane permanently
If enemy sends 2+ to stop, team takes objective 4v3
TF R teleports to join any fight
Janna/Karma disengage keeps team safe
counter: Force fights when global ults on CD

comps.name: Full Engage Lockdown
comps.win: Triple engage ults force teamfights. Enemy can't dodge 3+ AoE engage tools.
play: Leona R → Malphite R → Diana R → Galio R layered
Even if one dodged, 2 more coming
Jinx rockets from backline
Force fights at every objective
synergies: Malphite R → Diana R double knockup
Leona R + Galio R layered stun
Galio R on Diana for guaranteed landing

comps.name: Drain Tank Sustain
comps.win: Sustain through fights with healing/drain. Enemy can't kill you.
play: Extended fights favor you — draw fights out
Vlad R + Swain R = massive AoE drain
Olaf R ignores CC and runs at carries
If GW built, shift to burst
synergies: Swain R + Vladimir R double drain

comps.name: CC Chain Lockdown
comps.win: Chain CC so enemies are locked down 5+ seconds. Can't play if can't move.
play: Nautilus hook → root → R knockup → Jhin W root → Lissandra R
Target doesn't move for 5-7 seconds
Sion Q + Sejuani R for encore
Even Olaf R can't save from 7 CC sources
counter: Morgana E blocks entire CC chain
synergies: Nautilus CC → Jhin W root extension
Sejuani passive stun from any CC

comps.name: Enchanter Aura Stack
comps.win: Double enchanter auras stack heals/shields. Team is unkillable in extended fights.
play: Seraphine W + Sona W = massive AoE healing
Seraphine R → Sona R chain CC
Ardent + Staff on both = team-wide buffs
Don't fight early. Scale to 3 items
counter: Hard engage bursts before shields apply

comps.name: Lovers' Duo
comps.win: Xayah + Rakan designed synergy. Rakan engages, Xayah follows with E root.
play: Rakan W+R → Xayah feathers → E root on charmed enemies
Rakan E back to Xayah from extended range
Shared recall for tempo
Orianna ball on Rakan for combo

comps.name: Triple Hyperscale
comps.win: Survive to 3+ items. Kayle 15 + Kassadin 13 + Vayne 3 items = unstoppable.
play: SURVIVE early. Farm farm farm
Kayle R makes carry invulnerable
Vayne shreds tanks, Kassadin deletes squishies
At 25+ min, outscale everything
synergies: Lulu R saves whichever carry focused

comps.name: Early Aggression Snowball
comps.win: Win every lane. Snowball kills into gold lead. End before 20 minutes.
play: Leona level 2 all-in with Draven = first blood
Lee Sin perma-gank from level 3
Zed roams bot after 5 for triple kill dive
Take every dragon. End by 18 min
counter: Survive to 20 min — early comps fall off
synergies: Zed R + Lee Sin R combo

comps.name: AoE Zone Delete
comps.win: J4 R traps → Kennen R + Rumble R + MF R inside arena = instant teamwipe.
play: J4 E+Q + R Cataclysm traps 3+
Kennen Flash + R inside Cataclysm
Rumble R Equalizer through arena
MF R on trapped enemies
counter: Spread out so J4 can't trap multiple
synergies: J4 Cataclysm + Rumble R fire arena
Rell R pull groups for J4

comps.name: Reset Chain Comp
comps.win: Get ONE kill → chain resets. Viego possess, Katarina E, Jinx passive, Kha'Zix E.
play: Thresh hook starts with a pick
Katarina kill → E reset → R → chain pentakill
Viego kill → possess → heal → R → chain
Jinx kill → passive → runs down rest
counter: DON'T die first — no resets trigger
Group tight so resets can't chain
synergies: Katarina E + Jinx passive on same kill

comps.name: Anti-Dive Peel Fortress
comps.win: Nobody can dive your carry. Poppy W blocks dashes. Janna R pushes away.
play: Poppy W = ALL dashes blocked in zone
Janna R pushes everyone away + heals
Orianna E shield + R peel
Vayne front-to-back, team peels
counter: Olaf R ignores Poppy W and Janna R

comps.name: Global Ult Pressure
comps.win: 3+ global ults. Apply pressure everywhere. Enemy never feels safe.
play: Shen splits → R to team if dove
TF R reveals map + teleports
Nocturne R darkness → dive anywhere
Soraka R global heal, Jinx R cross-map execute
counter: Deep ward to see TF/Nocturne R
Force fights when global Rs on CD
synergies: TF R + Nocturne R double global dive
Shen R + Soraka R double global save

comps.name: Support Flex (User Pool)
comps.win: Flex support counter-pick based on team/enemy comp. 7-champion deep pool covers all situations.
play: Draft support LAST — counter-pick
Nautilus into squishy ADC = kills
Karma into poke = match poke + shield
Soraka/Milio into dive = keep carry alive
